title: Colossians Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Colossians 3: setting the mind on things above, putting off the old and putting on the new, and work done heartily for the Lord.

questions.text: If they were raised together with Christ, what are they to seek, and where is Christ said to be?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says that if they were raised with Christ, they are to seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

answers.text: The things that are near, where the assembly gathers
The things that are above, where Christ is seated on the right hand of God
The things that are promised, where the fathers waited
The things that are hidden, where no eye has seen

questions.text: Where does verse 3 say their life is hidden?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says "For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God."

answers.text: In the word of truth
In the hope laid up for them
Among the saints in light
With Christ in God

questions.text: Which things does verse 5 tell them to put to death?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 names sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

answers.text: Sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire and covetousness
Philosophy, vain deceit and the traditions of men
Eating, drinking and the keeping of feast days and new moons
Self-abasement, the worship of angels and severity to the body

questions.text: Which things does verse 8 tell them to put away now?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says they are now to put away anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of their mouth.

answers.text: Idleness, drunkenness and quarrels over money
Fear, doubt and faintness of heart
Anger, wrath, malice, slander and shameful speaking
Boasting, flattery and empty words

questions.text: After whose image does verse 10 say the new man is being renewed?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says they have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator.

answers.text: The image of the first man
The image of the saints in light
The image of the assembly
The image of his Creator

questions.text: Which distinctions does verse 11 say cannot be there?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says there cannot be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant or free person, but Christ is all and in all.

answers.text: Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant or free
Rich and poor, strong and weak, the young and the old
Teacher and learner, overseer and servant, widow and orphan
Husband and wife, parent and child, neighbor and stranger

questions.text: What are they to put on as God's chosen ones, holy and beloved?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 tells them to put on a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance.

answers.text: The whole armor of God, with the shield of faith
The hope which is laid up for them in the heavens
A heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility and perseverance
The knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom

questions.text: What does verse 14 call the bond of perfection?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says that above all these things they are to walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

answers.text: Peace
Love
Faith
Thankfulness

questions.text: With what are they to teach and admonish one another?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says to let the word of Christ dwell in them richly, teaching and admonishing one another in all wisdom with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in their heart to the Lord.

answers.text: Parables and sayings of the fathers
Letters read aloud in the assembly
Signs given to those who believe
Psalms, hymns and spiritual songs

questions.text: How are they to work, and what does verse 24 say they will receive?
questions.explanation: Verses 23 and 24 say that whatever they do, they are to work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men, knowing that from the Lord they will receive the reward of the inheritance.

answers.text: Heartily, as for the Lord, and they will receive the reward of the inheritance
Quietly, as before men, and they will receive praise from their masters
Diligently, as under the law, and they will receive a share of the land
Gladly, as for the saints, and they will receive comfort in affliction
